row_cells.Evidence / check: fla 0.6.0 signature is `fused_recurrent_gated_delta_rule(q, k, v, g=None, gk=None, gv=None, beta=None, scale=...)` (read in the installed source); `tests/test_gdn_kernels.py` called it as `(q, k, v, g, beta, scale=)`, so beta went in as `gk` (a per-key log decay) and real beta defaulted to ones: the "NaN" was our call, not the GPU. Test and SQ50 script now use keywords. Re-test: SQ70 (3 GPU-min).
